specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a friendly cartoon artist robot sits in front of a glowing canvas, holding a chunky steering wheel that is wired into the canvas with soft colored cables. Beside the robot, an old slot-machine lever droops, switched off and forgotten on the floor. On the canvas a half-painted scene of a small house follows neat guide lines that match a faint sketch outline pinned next to it, showing the robot steering the picture rather than gambling for it. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, with expressive characters and minimal visual clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. The humor should be gentle and immediately understandable: a painter who finally has a wheel instead of a lever. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A cartoon artist robot grips a steering wheel wired into a painting canvas while a discarded slot-machine lever lies switched off on the floor, the painted house tracing faint guide lines, illustrating how controllable generation replaces the random text-to-image slot machine with a precise steering wheel over layout, identity, and edits.
specs.caption: Chapter 34 handed you a slot machine; this chapter bolts on a steering wheel. The model will still surprise you, but only inside the lines you drew.

specs.anchorText: Every control method exposes a single most important hyperparameter at inference time: how strongly the control signal acts.
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a single large friendly dial or knob in the center, with a cheerful robot turning it. Three small thumbnail vignettes fan out around the dial like clock positions to show what the setting does: at the low setting a robot paints a loose, free, dreamy doodle ignoring a thin dotted outline; at the middle setting the robot neatly paints a tidy picture that follows the dotted outline; at the high setting the robot strains and sweats as the picture is squashed and warped, rigidly forced onto the outline with cracks and glitches. The dial is the hero of the image. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor: more is not better, just more obedient. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A central obedience dial turned by a robot, with three vignettes showing the tradeoff: low setting yields a loose free doodle ignoring the outline, middle setting traces the outline neatly, and high setting warps and cracks the image by forcing it rigidly onto the outline, illustrating that conditioning scale trades obedience against creative freedom rather than image quality.
specs.caption: The conditioning scale is an obedience dial, not a quality dial: cranking it past one does not sharpen the picture, it just forces the brush to trace lines the prompt would rather ignore.

specs.anchorText: A new concept can be injected at any of these stages.
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: three friendly cartoon characters injecting a new idea about a small pet dog into a generator machine at three different points along a left-to-right pipeline, sized to show increasing effort. On the left, a tiny sprite drops a single small glowing word-card into the machine's input slot, light and easy. In the middle, a medium helper clips a couple of small patch-like adapters onto the machine's gears. On the right, a large character with rolled-up sleeves rebuilds the entire machine with tools and scaffolding, the heaviest job. Each character holds a small picture of the same cute dog they are teaching the machine. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor: same dog, three very different amounts of sweat. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: Three cartoon characters teach a generator the same pet dog with escalating effort: a tiny sprite drops one glowing word-card into the input slot, a medium helper clips small adapter patches onto the gears, and a large worker rebuilds the whole machine, mapping textual inversion, LoRA, and DreamBooth onto a spectrum from smallest change to largest.
specs.caption: Textual inversion adds one word, LoRA clips on a small patch, DreamBooth rebuilds the whole machine: three points on one spectrum from least effort and expressiveness to most, all teaching the model the very same dog.

specs.anchorText: The mask is the contract: white means "you may repaint here," black means "leave this exactly alone."
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a polite painter robot standing in front of a cozy room scene, holding a paintbrush, with a roped-off white rectangular zone marked on the wall where a potted plant is being painted. Around the white zone, a soft velvet rope on little posts (like a museum barrier) keeps the robot strictly inside the allowed area; the rest of the room (sofa, window, floor) is clearly off-limits and untouched. The robot looks discreet and professional, painting only inside the roped zone. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor: a very rule-abiding painter who stays behind the rope. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A polite painter robot paints a potted plant strictly inside a roped-off white rectangle on a room wall while the sofa, window, and floor outside the rope stay untouched, illustrating how an inpainting mask is a contract where white means repaint here and black means leave everything else exactly alone.
specs.caption: An inpainting mask is a contract, not a suggestion: the model may paint anything it likes inside the white zone and must leave every pixel outside the rope exactly as it found them.

specs.anchorText: what noise would this model have started from to produce this exact image?
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a thoughtful detective robot with a magnifying glass studying a finished photograph pinned to a board, and tracing colored string backward from the clear photo to a fuzzy cloud of TV-static noise, as if reverse-engineering exactly which speckled noise pattern would have produced this picture. Two routes are gently suggested: one path leads to a slightly different stranger's face (a near-miss), and the correct traced path leads back to the same face. The detective looks careful and a little obsessive. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor: a forensic detective reconstructing a dream from the noise. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A detective robot with a magnifying glass traces colored string backward from a finished photo to a fuzzy cloud of static noise, with one path leading to a near-miss stranger's face and the correct path returning the same face, illustrating DDIM inversion recovering the specific noise that regenerates this exact image so edits stay faithful.
specs.caption: To edit a real photo the model must first reverse-engineer the exact noise it would have hallucinated to paint it; recover any old noise and you get a stranger who merely resembles your subject.

specs.anchorText: Skip a step and you will spend the afternoon wondering why the cat has two shadows
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette: a baffled robot pipeline-builder scratching its head while looking at an edited scene of a cat that has gone wrong: the cat casts two shadows, one a normal gray and the other a strange purple shadow that nothing is casting, and a faint visible rectangular outline frames the spot where an object was pasted in. A small row of conveyor-belt stages behind the robot (segment, inpaint, upscale, color-match) shows the assembly line that produced the mess, with one stage clearly out of order. The style should be friendly and approachable, like a comic strip or an XKCD-inspired infographic, expressive characters, minimal clutter, clean white background, generous margins. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle humor: a debugging robot confronting a cat with two shadows. Keep the composition simple and focused on one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A baffled robot inspects an edited cat that casts two shadows, one normal gray and one impossible purple, plus a faint rectangle marking a pasted-in edit, with a conveyor belt of segment, inpaint, upscale, and color-match stages running out of order behind it, illustrating how chaining editing stages in the wrong order produces telltale lighting and seam failures.
specs.caption: A doubled or purple shadow is a pipeline confession: when stages run out of order, the new object arrives lit by a sun nobody else in the scene agrees on, and the bug is almost never in the stage you are staring at.
